name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 7 visits over 39 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 42 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 39 hours starting 2026-02-16, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 4.39 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
